messages:
sam_account_exec: Heads-up: Meridian Bank wants to swap out RivalAPI and asked for a short POC. Main asks: request/response parity, identical sampling knobs, EU-only data, SSO, and a clear migration path + pricing. Thoughts?
neha_solution: We should propose an adapter + parity harness. Steps: 1) quick shim to accept Rival payloads, 2) run their canonical prompt set through both endpoints, 3) measure intent agreement + response divergence, 4) document differences and recommended prompt templates.
tom_infra: For POC infra we can spin a scoped Dedicated instance in eu-central with isolated control plane. Suggest cap: 50k tokens/day for 14 days. Autoscale off by default, enable burst pools if they need throughput tests.
sam_account_exec: They asked whether we can mirror top_k/top_p/temp to get closer outputs. Also worried about token accounting differences and billing during POC.
neha_solution: We can expose sampling params in the shim and run A/B with same seeds where supported. Call out that exact byte-for-byte parity is unlikely; aim for behavioral parity (intent + entity extraction). For billing: offer POC credits and a one-time invoice option for dedicated infra.
owen_security: Security checklist: SAML SSO, EU data residency (no US egress), BYOK for at-rest, field-level redaction for PHI. They will send a security questionnaire (~30-45 pages). If they insist on on-prem, timelines jump 3-4 weeks.
claire_legal: Please route questionnaire to security@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com. For DPAs and addenda, expect 7-14 business days depending on redlines. If they require custom logging access we need an NDA amendment.
provision-bot: POC project created: meridian-poc-001 (region: eu-central-1). Invite sent to sam_account_exec.
neha_solution: Draft shim mapping notes: RivalAPI uses POST /v1/respond with body {prompt, params, user_id}, Redwood uses POST /v1/completions or /v1/chat with messages. Minimal translation: rival.prompt -> messages = [{role: "user", content: prompt}], preserve params.top_k/top_p/temp -> sampling. Also translate rival.stream -> our streaming SSE endpoint.
neha_solution: Quick cURL example to validate shim locally:
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/respond \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize account activity","params":{"top_k":40,"temp":0.2}}'
```
sam_account_exec: Meridian also cares about small differences in policy filter behavior. Will we gate content filters differently than Rival?
owen_security: We'll run policy checks at two points: pre-serve (customer-side) and post-serve in Redwood with the same ruleset. If policy outcomes differ we flag as a failure case for parity.
neha_solution: Parity metrics (proposal): 1) Intent accuracy (binary) target >= 94%, 2) Embedding cosine mean >= 0.89, 3) Token-length variance < 15%, 4) Safety-filter agreement >= 98%. We'll produce a CSV of diffs and an issues.md with remediation prompts.
tom_infra: Early perf targets for POC: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 220ms for their average payload (approx 350 tokens). If they push longer contexts we'll advise quantized model variants.
claire_legal: Note on export controls and crypto: if they use BYOK we need KMS region constraints documented in the DPA.
sam_account_exec: Action list: Neha build shim + demo harness by Thu, Tom provision POC infra and send cost estimate, Owen/Claire standby for questionnaire review. I'll schedule kickoff Fri 14:00 CET.
neha_solution: I'll ship a dockerized harness and a small node shim. Expected PR by Wed.
owen_security: When questionnaire arrives ping me with a summary of high-risk asks.
provision-bot: reminder: credentials for meridian-poc-001 will expire in 10 days.
sam_account_exec: Thanks team. I'll follow up with Meridian to get their canonical prompt set and sample Rival call logs. :+1:
